title: TabMF: Learning Dataset Representations with Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13818v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Representations of supervised datasets support higher-level machine-learning tasks such as dataset retrieval and distribution-shift monitoring. However, existing approaches typically rely either on hand-crafted meta-features or on dataset encoders trained specifically for representation learning. We introduce TabMF, a framework that repurposes pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs) as encoders of supervised datasets. TabMF equips a predictive TFM with an architecture-aware dataset-level readout and adapts the model end-to-end using contrastive post-training on stochastic views of synthetic supervised datasets. We instantiate TabMF on TabICLv2 and TabPFN-2.5 and evaluate the resulting representations across six tasks on unseen real datasets. translated_title: TabMF：基于表格基础模型学习数据集表示
translated_abstract: 有监督数据集的表示可以支持更高层次的机器学习任务，例如数据集检索和分布偏移监测。然而，现有方法通常要么依赖手工设计的元特征，要么依赖专门为表示学习训练的数据集编码器。我们提出了TabMF，这是一个将预训练表格基础模型（TFMs）重新用作有监督数据集编码器的框架。TabMF为预测型TFM配备了一个架构感知的数据集级读出层，并通过对合成有监督数据集的随机视图进行对比后训练，实现模型的端到端适配。我们在TabICLv2和TabPFN-2.5上实例化了TabMF，并在未见过的真实数据集上通过六项任务评估了所得的表示。简单的冻结TFM读出层即可产生具有竞争力的表示，这表明预测性预训练本身已经诱导出了实质性的数据集级结构。两个TabMF编码器取得了最强的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TabMF提出了一种框架，通过架构感知的数据集级读出层和基于合成数据随机视图的对比后训练，将预训练表格基础模型（TabICLv2与TabPFN-2.5）重新用作有监督数据集的编码器，从而在数据集检索和分布偏移监测等任务上学习到强大的数据集级表示。
en_tdlr: TabMF repurposes pretrained tabular foundation models (TabICLv2, TabPFN-2.5) as encoders of supervised datasets through an architecture-aware dataset-level readout and contrastive post-training on synthetic data views, achieving strong dataset-level representations across tasks like dataset retrieval and distribution-shift monitoring.
